summary.business_type: Informational publisher (travel entry-form guides, YMYL-adjacent), trilingual en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant
top_findings: ChatGPT referrals fell 96% (978 sessions in 90d vs 24 in last 28d); decline began 2026-08-08, before the 08-10 middleman-list removal
43/50 English country hubs carry bare country-name titles; all 150 hubs emit no JSON-LD
Pages ranking 6-11 have 0.4-1.7% CTR (uk, singapore, india, indonesia how-to-fill)
Titles too long: 91/156 en and 133/156 per Chinese locale exceed ~65 width; Chinese site title adds a double brand suffix
Indonesia (2026-06-17) and Dominican (2026-04-24) official-URL verification dates are stale on top traffic pages
quick_wins: Single-brand Chinese site title in config.toml
Keyword titles for 43 en + 6 zh hubs
Rewrite title/description of four how-to-fill pages around the GSC field queries
Emit BreadcrumbList + CollectionPage on hub pages
Re-verify Indonesia and Dominican official URLs
